typography.note: Inputs never go below 16px — smaller sizes make iOS Safari zoom on focus.

motion.note: Every animation must have a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.

patterns: full-screen brand loader before Stripe redirect

must: Plain HTML, CSS and browser JS only — there is no build step and no package.json
Add styles to css/style.css; it is the single stylesheet and the agreed styling base
Danish is the source language; new user-facing strings must be registered in js/i18n.js (EN + ES)
Mobile-first — most visitors and the owner are on iPhone
Touch targets at least 44px; keyboard focus visible via :focus-visible
avoid: React, JSX, Tailwind, shadcn or any framework output
npm dependencies, bundlers, CDN scripts or external stylesheets
New fonts or new colour palettes — the palette above is fixed
Layout overhauls or redesigns; changes stay polish-level
Hover-only affordances that stick after a tap on touch devices

decisions: Cream + brand-blue palette is derived from the printed flour label artwork and is not up for redesign
The cart drawer uses visibility (not display:none) so its slide animation can run
Closing the cart reloads only on the homepage, where the fixed video stage causes iOS render artifacts
evidence: css/style.css — radii, shadows and motion curves in use
js/i18n.js — Danish source strings with EN/ES dictionaries
